title: DroneGuard: RF Detection & Signal Analysis
description: A research prototype exploring RF detection, spectrum visualization, and drone-related signal classification using SDR, GNU Radio, and MATLAB. This is separate from my ongoing final-year project in semantic communication.

title: IoT Fleet Management & GPS Tracking System
description: Led development within a team on an ESP32 fleet and driver logging system across RDC and HIT internships. Integrated GPS, RFID and cellular MQTT telemetry with Flask, SQL Server, geofencing, driving-event analysis and an operator dashboard.

title: Real-Time Object Detection Dashboard
description:
Real-time object detection system built on YOLOv8, wrapped in an interactive
                        Streamlit dashboard for live video upload and detection logging. Packaged with Docker
                        Compose for one-command deployment. Demoed at NUST Robotics Society's Voltfest 2026.

title: EEG Signal Cleaning & Analysis
description:
Cleaned raw EEG recordings from a Parkinson's patient using a cascade of notch,
                        high-pass, and low-pass filters. Built an interactive MATLAB App Designer GUI to
                        toggle each filter stage and visualize the cleaned signal in real time.

title: 4-bit ALU Design
description:
Arithmetic Logic Unit designed from discrete logic gates, supporting arithmetic
                        and logical operations selected via a function-select input, mirroring the core
                        compute unit inside a processor. Verified across all 256 input combinations.

title: FM Receiver Using TDA7000 IC
description:
FM receiver built around the TDA7000 single-chip IC, covering front-end tuning,
                        local oscillator calculations, and full block-level system design. Verified
                        demodulation in MATLAB/Simulink before building and testing the physical circuit.

title: Credit Risk Classification Model
description:
Credit-scoring classification model comparing Logistic Regression, Decision Trees,
                        and Random Forest on applicant financial-history data, evaluated with Precision,
                        Recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC.

title: AMI-Based IoT Smart Energy Meter
description: An ESP32 smart energy-meter simulation in Proteus, exploring sensing, energy accumulation, and an IoT monitoring workflow. Hardware prototyping is planned.
